info.title: Otlob Auto Parts Marketplace & Delivery API
info.description: High-scale, on-demand automotive parts marketplace backend with Split Cart Checkout, Geospatial Courier Dispatching, and Double-Entry Accounting Ledger.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Multi-role registration, login, Sanctum token issuance and device FCM push tokens.

tags.name: Catalog & Fitment
tags.description: High-scale part search by OEM number, SKU, and vehicle Make/Model/Year compatibility.

tags.name: Customer & Orders
tags.description: Customer garage management, multi-merchant split cart checkout, and real-time live delivery tracking.

tags.name: Merchant Management
tags.description: Automotive part catalogue publishing, stock adjustment, sub-order fulfillment, and merchant ledger wallet.

tags.name: Courier Fleet & Dispatch
tags.description: Live Redis GPS beacon pinging, status toggle, order acceptance, counter pickup, delivery OTP verification, and remittance submission.

tags.name: Admin Operations & Financials
tags.description: Merchant/courier vetting, platform-wide order monitoring, cash remittance audits, and financial ledger revenue reports.
